primary_competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts
diagnosis: Sarcomeric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy due to MYH7
mechanism: MYH7 encodes beta-cardiac myosin heavy chain, a thick-filament motor protein of the sarcomere. Pathogenic variants in MYH7 are a major autosomal-dominant cause of nonsyndromic hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
vignette: A young adult with a family history of sudden cardiac death has exertional syncope. Echocardiography shows unexplained asymmetric left-ventricular hypertrophy. Genetic testing identifies a pathogenic variant in MYH7.
lead: The affected gene encodes a protein that is primarily located in which sarcomeric structure?
distractor_notes: Thin-filament/Z-disc proteins are distinct sarcomeric components; MYH7 encodes beta-myosin heavy chain, a major thick-filament motor protein.
L-type calcium channels are membrane excitation-contraction components and are not encoded by MYH7.
Desmosomal proteins such as plakophilin-2 are implicated in arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy rather than MYH7 HCM.
RYR2 encodes the sarcoplasmic-reticulum calcium-release channel and is not the MYH7 product.
key_expl: MYH7 encodes beta-cardiac myosin heavy chain. Myosin heavy chains form the motor component of the sarcomere thick filament and interact cyclically with actin during contraction. MYH7 and MYBPC3 are among the most common genes implicated in sarcomeric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
objective: Identify beta-myosin heavy chain encoded by MYH7 as a sarcomere thick-filament protein in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
